targets.expected_alt_text: The ochre/magenta letterpress ring makes Harness dominant. targets.expected_alt_text: One diagonal translucent cyanotype prism exposes five trust facets. Validation has Source papers; Objectivity exposes Conflicting evidence; Transparency opens a Method record; Privacy contrasts Authorized files with the closed Outside scope compartment; Accountability is paired with Human responsibility. The sole arrow touches actual source-paper and method-record ports, avoiding labels. The exploratory17-interview note is now detached without its stray guide. Twelve exact labels are present once. This continuous faceted prism differs from the earlier diagonal vellum folios and the three locked current structures.

targets.expected_alt_text: The matte teaching relief exposes Observed facts and User framing as two facets of Subjective retelling. One arrow enters the cradle containing two distinct, unnumbered competing-motive forms. Hidden motive remains in a sealed separate capsule paired with Evaluation only by a nondirectional brace; it never feeds inference. Ask for details is a smaller side branch. Event record has only its exact label: the fake lines and all botanical ornament are gone. Synthetic interactions is plain detached scope text. Nine exact labels occur once, with source-limited inference rather than a diagnosis. The actual dominant skeleton is a branching-tree, with a central fork, separate ground truth and a smaller clarification arm.

targets.expected_alt_text: The large off-center pencil-paper specimen names Ideas, Administration, Summaries and Data analysis under Lower adjusted use; the smaller magnification isolates Medical care and Higher adjusted use. The new top heading explicitly identifies Health vs other occupations, preventing a mistaken within-task denominator. A single survey-evidence arrow enters the physical comparison specimen, while magnification guides are nondirectional. Both combined-role/survey and unmeasured-productivity caveats remain detached. Twelve exact labels occur once; no quantitative bar, invented percentage or causal productivity claim appears. The observed dominant topology is asymmetric-inset, with a much larger general-task body and a subordinate clinical exception.
targets.headline: Health workers report less general-purpose workplace AI use
targets.visual_finding: General tasks lower adjusted use contrasts with the smaller Medical care higher adjusted use inset; Survey evidence and Use is not productivity make the observational limit explicit.
